title: 1. Subject-Verb Agreement र वाक्यको जग (1/2)
group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: वाक्यका आधारभूत भागहरू, र ती ८ वटा agreement case जसले तपाईंको अंक निर्धारण गर्छन्। पूरै परीक्षामा सबैभन्दा कम मेहनतमा accuracy-मा सबैभन्दा ठूलो फाइदा यहीँबाट आउँछ।

IELTS-का कुनै खास technique-मा जानुअघि तपाईंका वाक्यहरू संरचनाका हिसाबले ठीक हुनैपर्छ। यो module-ले ती ४ वटा गल्ती सुधार्छ, जसले तपाईंको Writing र Speaking-को हरेक लाइनमा चुपचाप अंक घटाइरहेका हुन्छन्: subject-सँग नमिल्ने verb, घटनालाई गलत समयमा राख्ने tense, छुटेका वा गलत ठाउँमा राखिएका article, र गलत preposition। यीमध्ये कुनै पनि गाह्रो छैन। सबै बानीका कुरा हुन्। Module 1 ले सही बानीलाई तपाईंको स्वाभाविक बानी बनाउँछ, ताकि Module 2 सम्म पुग्दा तपाईं यस्तो जगमाथि ठूला र महत्वाकांक्षी वाक्य बनाउन सक्नुहोस्, जहाँबाट अंक चुहिँदैन।
1.1 सुरुमा, वाक्यका आधारभूत भागहरू (आफूलाई थाहा छ जस्तो लागे पनि यहीँबाट सुरु गर्नुहोस्)

यो किताबले तपाईंलाई केही पनि थाहा छैन भनेर मान्छ, त्यसैले हामी वाक्यका भागहरूबाट सुरु गर्छौं। बंगाली बोल्न यी नामहरू कण्ठ गर्नु पर्दैन, तर यो किताबका लगभग हरेक नियम यिनै नामहरू प्रयोग गरेर भनिएका छन्, त्यसैले यिनलाई चिन्न सिक्नुहोस्।
हरेक साधारण English वाक्यमा २ वटा अनिवार्य भाग हुन्छन्, र प्रायः तेस्रो भाग पनि हुन्छ:
Subject भनेको त्यो व्यक्ति वा चीज हो जसको बारेमा वाक्य छ, अर्थात् काम गर्ने। “Students study hard,” मा subject हो students।
Verb भनेको काम वा कुनै अवस्था हो। “Students study hard,” मा verb हो study। Verb be (is, am, are, was, were) ले काम होइन, अवस्था देखाउँछ: “The graph is clear.”
Object भनेको त्यो व्यक्ति वा चीज हो जसमाथि काम हुन्छ। “Students use the internet,” मा object हो the internet।
English-को सामान्य क्रम हो Subject + Verb + Object (S + V + O)। Students (S) use (V) the internet (O).

बंगाली Subject-Object-Verb भाषा हो। আমি ভাত খাই को शाब्दिक अर्थ हो “I rice eat,” जहाँ verb एकदम अन्त्यमा छ। English-मा verb दोस्रो स्थानमा, subject-को ठीक पछि आउँछ: “I eat rice.” तपाईंले लेखेको कुनै English वाक्य गलत लागे, सबैभन्दा पहिले बंगाली बानीले verb वाक्यको अन्त्यतिर सरेको छ कि छैन जाँच्नुहोस्।

“Agreement” को अर्थ हो मिल्नु। Subject-verb agreement भनेको verb-ले number-मा आफ्नो subject-सँग मिल्नुपर्छ भन्ने नियम हो। Singular subject (एउटा) ले verb-को एउटा रूप लिन्छ; plural subject (एकभन्दा बढी) ले अर्को रूप। पूरा कुरा यत्ति हो। यो chapter-को बाँकी भाग ती case-हरूको बारेमा छ जहाँ असली subject चिन्न गाह्रो हुन्छ।
Present simple tense-मा subject singular हो कि plural, त्यसअनुसार verb बदलिन्छ।
हजारौं बंगलादेशी candidate फस्ने यो पासोमा ध्यान दिनुहोस्: noun र verb-मा -s को अर्थ उल्टो हुन्छ।
Noun-मा -s को अर्थ plural हो: one student, many students।
Verb-मा -s को अर्थ singular हो: he works, they work।
त्यसैले सही वाक्यमा प्रायः -s या त noun-मा हुन्छ या verb-मा, तर दुवैमा हुँदैन: The student works. (singular noun, verb-मा -s लाग्छ) / The students work. (plural noun, verb-मा -s हुँदैन)
Verb be र have irregular हुन्, यिनलाई कण्ठ गर्नैपर्छ:
The result is clear. / The results are clear. The number has risen. / The numbers have risen.

title: 1. Subject-Verb Agreement र वाक्यको जग (2/2)
group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: 1.3 तपाईंको अंक साँच्चै निर्धारण गर्ने case-हरू

मूल नियम सजिलो छ। अंक काटिने चाहिँ तलका case-हरूमा हो, जहाँ असली subject लुकेको हुन्छ, अर्कै रूपमा हुन्छ, वा नजिकैको अर्को noun भन्दा verb-बाट टाढा हुन्छ। यी ८ वटा राम्ररी सिक्नुहोस्, तपाईंको लेखाइबाट लगभग सबै agreement गल्ती हट्छन्।
Case 1 · Subject र verb-को बीचका शब्दहरू
Verb असली subject-सँग मिल्छ, सबैभन्दा नजिकको noun-सँग कहिल्यै होइन। लेख्नेहरू सबैभन्दा नजिकको शब्दतिर तानिन्छन्, र त्यो प्रायः गलत हुन्छ।
The list of items are on the table.
The list of items is on the table.
Subject “list” (singular) हो, “items” होइन। बीचको phrase काटिदिनुहोस्, सत्य स्पष्ट हुन्छ: “The list … is.”
The quality of the answers were poor.
The quality of the answers was poor.
Technique: subject पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्, अनि त्यो र verb-को बीचका सबै शब्द मनमनै मेटाउनुहोस्। “The list of items is.”
Case 2 · “The number of” र “a number of”
यो जोडी Writing Task 1 मा बारम्बार आउँछ, र दुवैले एकअर्काको उल्टो व्यवहार गर्छन्।
“The number of + plural noun” ले singular verb लिन्छ (subject number हो, एउटा अंक)।
“A number of + plural noun” ले plural verb लिन्छ (यसको अर्थ केवल ‘धेरै वटा’ हो)।
The number of tourists has increased since 2010. / A number of tourists were waiting outside the museum.
Government, team, committee, family, company, public, staff जस्ता शब्दले एउटा समूहको नाम बुझाउँछन्। IELTS academic writing-मा हरेकलाई एउटै एकाइ मानेर singular verb प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
The government is planning three new policies. / The committee has reached a decision.

(British English-मा कहिलेकाहीँ plural verb पनि चल्छ, जब जोड समूहका छुट्टाछुट्टै सदस्यमा हुन्छ: “the team are arguing among themselves.” IELTS academic Writing-मा singular नै राख्नुहोस् र एकनासले राख्नुहोस्। यो सुरक्षित छ र कहिल्यै गलत हुँदैन।)
Each, every, everyone, everybody, someone, anyone, nobody, either, neither, one — यी सबै singular हुन्, वरिपरिका शब्द जतिसुकै plural देखिए पनि।
Each of the students has a laptop. (“have” होइन) / Everyone in the classes was present. / Neither of the options is acceptable.
यी जोडी connector-हरूसँग verb नजिकको subject-सँग मिल्छ, अर्थात् verb-को सबैभन्दा नजिक भएको subject-सँग।

Neither the manager nor the employees were informed. (नजिकको subject: employees, plural) / Neither the employees nor the manager was informed. (नजिकको subject: manager, singular) / Not only the students but also the teacher was worried.
And ले जोडिएका २ वटा subject लगभग सधैं plural हुन्छन्।
The teacher and the students were in the hall. / Poverty and unemployment remain serious problems.
अपवाद: जब दुई शब्दले मिलेर एउटै चीज बुझाउँछन्, तब singular मान्नुहोस्: “Bread and butter is a common breakfast.” IELTS-मा यो विरलै आउँछ।
There पछि verb असली subject-सँग मिल्छ, जुन verb पछि आउँछ।
There is a serious problem. (subject: problem, singular) / There are several factors. (subject: factors, plural) / There is a range of options. (subject: range, singular)
Case 8 · Uncountable noun, परिमाण, र inverted structure

Uncountable noun-लाई singular मानिन्छ र तिनले कहिल्यै plural -s लिँदैनन्। IELTS-मा धेरै आउने यो set एकैपटक कण्ठ गर्नुहोस्: information, advice, knowledge, research, equipment, furniture, accommodation, traffic, progress, news, money, water, work।
The informations are correct and he gave many advices.
The information is correct and he gave a lot of advice.
समय, पैसा र दूरीको परिमाणलाई एउटै मात्रा मानिन्छ, त्यसैले तिनले singular verb लिन्छन्। Ten years is a long time to wait. / Five thousand taka is not enough.

Inverted structure-मा (जहाँ verb subject भन्दा अगाडि आउँछ) पनि verb subject-सँगै मिल्छ। वाक्य not only वा hardly जस्ता negative adverb बाट सुरु हुँदा verb पछिको subject खोज्नुहोस् र त्यसैसँग मिलाउनुहोस्। Hardly ever does the government reverse such a decision. / Only after 2010 did the figures begin to fall.
(Inversion पूरा रूपमा Chapter 8 मा पढ्नुहुनेछ। यहाँ केवल agreement त्यहाँ पनि लागू हुन्छ भन्ने ख्याल गर्नुहोस्।)
बंगाली भाषीहरूले agreement-मा किन गल्ती गर्छन्

तपाईंले गर्ने लगभग हरेक subject-verb agreement गल्तीको जरा एउटै तथ्य हो: English verb जस्तो singular वा plural subject अनुसार आफ्नो ending बदल्छ, बंगाली verb त्यसरी बदलिँदैन। Verb-को रूप যায় (jay) “he” र “they” दुवैका लागि उस्तै हुन्छ। बंगालीले person र आदर (formality) देखाउँछ, तर English ले verb-मा माग्ने singular-plural बदलाव बंगालीमा अनिवार्य छैन। तपाईंको मातृभाषाले यो बदलावको बानी कहिल्यै बसालेन, त्यसैले यो छुट्दा तपाईंको कानले तपाईंलाई सचेत गराउँदैन।

Error type 1 · छुटेको third-person -s। बंगालीमा -s थपिँदैन, त्यसैले सिक्नेहरूले जताततै base verb लेख्छन्।
✗ He go to the market every day. / The population increase rapidly.
✓ He goes to the market every day. / The population increases rapidly.

Error type 2 · छुटेको वा गलत “is / are”। साधारण भनाइमा बंगालीमा प्रायः is का लागि छुट्टै शब्द हुँदैन (সে ভালো = “he good”), त्यसैले सिक्नेहरूले यसलाई छुटाउँछन् वा गलत number-को रूप छान्छन्।
✗ Many people is using the internet. / The graph show that pollution have increased.
✓ Many people are using the internet. / The graph shows that pollution has increased.
यो एउटै नियमले तपाईंको band किन रोक्छ

Examiner-ले सबैभन्दा पहिले subject-verb agreement-को गल्ती नै देख्छन्, किनकि यो लगभग हरेक उत्तरको पहिलो लाइनमै आउँछ र दोहोरिइरहन्छ। बारम्बार agreement गल्ती भएको script Grammatical Range and Accuracy मा Band 7 पुग्न सक्दैन, idea जतिसुकै राम्रा भए पनि, किनकि Band 7 को criterion अनुसार धेरैजसो वाक्य गल्तीरहित हुनुपर्छ। हरेक वाक्यमा एउटा agreement गल्ती भयो भने त्यो सम्भव हुँदैन। सबैभन्दा बढी नोक्सान Writing Task 1 मा हुन्छ, जुन the number of, the proportion of, the figure for जस्ता subject-मा चल्छ, र यी हरेक singular हुन्। Agreement सुधार्नु नै पूरै परीक्षामा सबैभन्दा कम मेहनतमा accuracy-मा सबैभन्दा ठूलो फाइदा हो।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 1: The number of visitors has risen sharply, whereas the proportion of local tourists has fallen.
Task 2: Although the government provides free healthcare, demand continues to outstrip supply.
Speaking Part 2: My family lives in a small town, and each of my brothers has a different job.
Chapter 1 यहाँ सकियो। अब Chapter 2 (Tense Mastery & Time Precision) आउँछ।

title: 1. Practice · Subject-Verb Agreement र वाक्यको जग
group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: Verb ले number-मा आफ्नो subject-सँग मिल्नुपर्छ, सबैभन्दा नजिकको noun-सँग होइन। Singular subject ले verb-को -s रूप लिन्छ; plural subject ले लिँदैन। यो एउटा बानी ठीक भयो भने तपाईंको लेखाइको सबैभन्दा सामान्य agreement गल्ती हट्छ।
**किन महत्वपूर्ण छ:** तपाईंले लेख्ने हरेक वाक्यमा subject-verb agreement जाँचिन्छ, त्यसैले यहाँको एउटा नराम्रो बानीले बारम्बार अंक काट्छ।
Present simple मा **singular subject** (he, she, it, एउटा चीज) ले verb **+ s/es** लिन्छ: the student works।
**Plural subject** ले **base verb** लिन्छ, -s बिना: the students work।
Noun र verb-मा -s उल्टो हुन्छ: noun-मा -s को अर्थ plural, verb-मा -s को अर्थ singular। सही वाक्यमा विरलै दुवैमा -s हुन्छ।
The result is clear र the results are clear; the number has risen र the numbers have risen।

blocks.title: Exercise 1.1 · गल्ती चिन्ने र सुधार्ने
blocks.instructions: तलका हरेक वाक्यमा एउटा subject-verb agreement गल्ती छ, तीन वटा बाहेक, जुन पहिल्यै सही छन्। गलत वाक्यहरूलाई सही गरी फेरि लेख्नुहोस्, र सही वाक्यहरूका लागि “Correct.” लेख्नुहोस्। Key हेर्नुअघि कलमले आफैं गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The list of approved candidates are posted on the noticeboard.
items.answer: The list of approved candidates is posted on the noticeboard.
accepted: The list of approved candidates is posted on the noticeboard.
items.reason: Subject “list” (singular) हो, “candidates” होइन।

items.prompt: Each of the students have submitted their assignment.
items.answer: Each of the students has submitted his or her assignment.
accepted: Each of the students has submitted his or her assignment.
Each of the students has submitted their assignment.
items.reason: “Each of” सधैं singular हुन्छ।

items.prompt: The government are introducing a new tax next year.
items.answer: The government is introducing a new tax next year.
accepted: The government is introducing a new tax next year.
items.reason: Collective noun-लाई एउटै एकाइ मान्दा academic writing-मा singular verb लाग्छ।

items.prompt: Neither the teacher nor the students was ready for the test.
items.answer: Neither the teacher nor the students were ready for the test.
accepted: Neither the teacher nor the students were ready for the test.
items.reason: “Neither…nor” सँग verb नजिकको subject “students” (plural) सँग मिल्छ।

items.prompt: The number of accidents on this road have increased.
items.answer: The number of accidents on this road has increased.
accepted: The number of accidents on this road has increased.
items.reason: “The number of” singular हो।

items.prompt: There is several reasons for this decline.
items.answer: There are several reasons for this decline.
accepted: There are several reasons for this decline.
items.reason: असली subject “reasons” plural हो।

items.prompt: A large amount of information were collected during the survey.
items.answer: A large amount of information was collected during the survey.
accepted: A large amount of information was collected during the survey.
items.reason: “Information” uncountable र singular हो, त्यसैले “amount … was.”

items.prompt: Ten kilometres are a long way to walk in the heat.
items.answer: Ten kilometres is a long way to walk in the heat.
accepted: Ten kilometres is a long way to walk in the heat.
items.reason: एउटा दूरीलाई एउटै मात्रा मानिन्छ: singular verb।

items.prompt: The committee has agreed on the final budget.
items.answer: Correct.
accepted: Correct.
Correct
The committee has agreed on the final budget.
items.reason: “Committee” लाई एउटै एकाइ मान्दा singular “has” लाग्छ।

items.prompt: The quality of the roads in rural areas are very poor.
items.answer: The quality of the roads in rural areas is very poor.
accepted: The quality of the roads in rural areas is very poor.
items.reason: Subject “quality” (singular) हो, “roads” वा “areas” होइन।

items.prompt: Poverty and illiteracy remains major obstacles to development.
items.answer: Poverty and illiteracy remain major obstacles to development.
accepted: Poverty and illiteracy remain major obstacles to development.
items.reason: “And” ले जोडिएका २ वटा subject plural हुन्छन्।

items.prompt: Everyone in the two classes were given a certificate.
items.answer: Everyone in the two classes was given a certificate.
accepted: Everyone in the two classes was given a certificate.
items.reason: “Everyone” singular हो।

items.prompt: Not only the manager but also the workers is unhappy with the plan.
items.answer: Not only the manager but also the workers are unhappy with the plan.
accepted: Not only the manager but also the workers are unhappy with the plan.
items.reason: “Not only…but also” सँग verb नजिकको subject “workers” (plural) सँग मिल्छ।

items.prompt: The data collected over ten years show a clear pattern.
items.answer: Correct.
accepted: Correct.
Correct
The data collected over ten years show a clear pattern.
items.reason: “Data” लाई plural वा mass noun मानिन्छ; यहाँ “the data … show” स्वीकार्य र एकनासको छ।

items.prompt: My knowledge of these topics are limited.
items.answer: My knowledge of these topics is limited.
accepted: My knowledge of these topics is limited.
items.reason: “Knowledge” uncountable र singular हो; subject “knowledge” हो, “topics” होइन।

items.prompt: A number of students has failed to register on time.
items.answer: A number of students have failed to register on time.
accepted: A number of students have failed to register on time.
items.reason: “A number of” को अर्थ “several” हो र यसले plural verb लिन्छ।

blocks: धेरैजसो agreement गल्ती मूल नियमबाट होइन, ती ८ वटा लुकेका case-बाट आउँछन् जहाँ असली subject लुकेको, ढिला आउने, वा अर्को noun-सँग जोडिएको हुन्छ। यी ८ वटा सिक्नुहोस्, तपाईंका essay-का लगभग सबै agreement गल्ती हराउँछन्।
**किन महत्वपूर्ण छ:** मूल नियम सजिलो छ; अंक काटिने चाहिँ ती case-हरूमा हो जहाँ असली subject चिन्न गाह्रो हुन्छ।
**Subject र verb-को बीचका शब्द:** तिनलाई बेवास्ता गर्नुहोस् -- verb असली subject-सँग मिल्छ, सबैभन्दा नजिकको noun-सँग होइन।
**"The number of" (singular) र "a number of" (plural):** the number of tourists has increased, तर a number of tourists were waiting।
**Collective noun** (government, team, committee): IELTS academic writing-मा singular।
**Indefinite pronoun** (each, everyone, neither) सधैं singular हुन्छन्।
**"And" ले जोडिएका compound subject**: लगभग सधैं plural।
**"There is / there are"**: verb पछि आउने कुरासँग मिल्छ।
**Uncountable noun र परिमाण** (information, ten years): plural जस्तो देखिए पनि singular।

blocks.instructions: तलको paragraph एउटा Band 5.5 Task 2 essay बाट लिइएको हो। यसमा १० वटा subject-verb agreement गल्ती छन्। ती खोज्नुहोस्, अनि पूरै paragraph सही गरी फेरि लेख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Nowadays, the number of people who works from home have increased dramatically. There is many reasons for this change. First, technology allow employees to stay connected from anywhere. In my opinion, the advantages of remote work outweighs the disadvantages, and this trend are likely to continue.
